//card: Source is the club's OWN miclub/GolfLink scorecard, photographed on the course (user-supplied, Aug 2026). Two tee sets: Blue (M) 4776 m par 66 ACR 65.0 / Slope 116, and Red (F) 4222 m par 67 ACR 67.0 / Slope 118. Every figure reconciles against the card's printed OUT/IN/TOTAL. Hole 18's Blue metres (346) is DERIVED as In 2327 minus the other eight, because bleed-through from the reverse obscures that one cell; the derivation is corroborated by Total 4776 = 2449 + 2327.
//supersedes: This replaces an earlier transcription of the club's BlueGolf listing, and the discrepancy is worth remembering before trusting BlueGolf for another club. Par matched hole for hole, but 14 of 18 stroke indexes were wrong and the 7th was 40 m long. The tell was that BlueGolf's indexes formed a tidy front-evens / back-odds split and put the LONGEST hole (9) at index 18; the real card is a properly mixed allocation with the 9th at index 2.
//tees: Blue (M) is the rated men's tee, so ratedTee/defaultTee are 'blue' — not 'white'. Red (F) has its own par (67; the 9th is a par 5 off Red) and its own stroke index, which the app does not yet apply per-tee, so Red is carried in _ladies rather than offered as a playable tee set that would be scored with men's par. Add it to teeSets once per-tee par/SI lands.
